midday.caption:
Markets price about 91% odds of a quarter point Fed hike on December 9 (CME FedWatch, market odds). Credit cards and HELOCs move with the Fed almost one for one, so variable debt is where you feel it first. Savers gain too, but slowly. The full breakdown is at fiopoin.com. evening.caption:
Oil keeps moving through Hormuz, but attacks now target the pipeline built to bypass it. Brent settled at $95.84 on Friday. Fuel costs reach airfares, heating bills and delivered goods with a lag of weeks. Our read, labeled as judgment: pump prices ease slowly unless the pipeline takes a serious hit. More at fiopoin.com.
